# Stand-in fixtures

Small real samples cut from the stand-in originals. Rows are real and unedited: all columns, source row order, no invented data. Generated by `scripts/cut_fixtures.py`, so do not edit by hand.

- Source: private release <https://github.com/afarah101/football-twin/releases/tag/stand-in-originals>. Each file is checked against the SHA-256 below before use.
- Reading `.rds`: `rdata.read_rds(path, default_encoding="utf8")`, 1-based index dropped, nulls converted to `pd.NA`.
- Written with: pandas 3.1.0, pyarrow 26.0.1, rdata 1.1.0.
- Re-cut: `python3 scripts/cut_fixtures.py <folder holding the release assets>`. Live Understat recordings replace these when Understat returns.

Source rows are 0-based positions in the source file.

## Cases not found

| Case | Result | Why |
|---|---|---|
| A `Sub` Pos label | NOT FOUND | FBref Pos has no `Sub` value in any stat file. Substitute appearances are taken from `Substitute` event rows instead. |
| HF row for the current-season player | NOT FOUND | HF stops at 2024-2025, so `understat_xg_data.csv` has no 2025-2026 rows. |
